verdict.rationale: Motion is an AI-powered productivity SaaS that handles user data, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training data policies, opt-outs, or data-use controls. The only related-sounding item, 'Permissions & Access Control', is an adjacent feature and is not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
